features.name: Contacts

features.name: Team
features.description: Team member management

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Overview dashboard

features.name: QuickBooks
features.description: QuickBooks sync — we integrate accounting, we do not replace it

features.name: Two-Way Texting
features.description: Unified SMS inbox — every customer conversation logged

features.name: Google Reviews
features.description: Connect your Google Business Profile — see your rating and reply to reviews from the CRM

features.name: Branded Email
features.description: support@yourdomain addresses — forward anywhere or receive replies in the CRM email inbox

features.name: Lead Inbox
features.description: Every inquiry in one inbox — marketplaces, ads, booking apps and your website

features.name: Review Requests
features.description: Ask customers for a Google review — sent automatically after a completed job or salon visit once switched on in Reviews › Settings, or by hand from Reviews

features.name: Email Marketing
features.description: Drip campaigns and newsletters

features.name: Barcode Scanning
features.description: Scan a part's or product's barcode with the phone's camera to find it — Stock on the phone, and the store's stock list

features.name: Product Catalog
features.description: Your products, their variants, prices and stock

features.name: Orders
features.description: Order management and history

features.name: Store Sales Reports
features.description: Sales over time, top products, repeat customers and the average order, for your own days

features.name: Store Stock Alerts
features.description: Set a level per product option; get one email when a sale takes it down to that level, and see what is running low

features.name: Store Customer Accounts
features.description: Shoppers sign in with an emailed link or code to see their own orders, keep addresses, order again and pay their group’s prices

features.name: Store Returns and Exchanges
features.description: Shoppers and staff start returns; you approve, receive the goods back, then refund to the card or store credit or send an exchange

features.name: Store Customer Segments
features.description: Save groups of customers by what they spent, how many orders they made and what they bought, and send campaigns and follow-up emails to them

features.name: Store Post-Purchase Emails
features.description: Email a customer after their order arrives: a first-order follow-up, a thank-you with products to go with it, and a reminder to reorder consumables

features.name: Store Supplier Reorders
features.description: Draft a purchase order for each supplier from what is running low, email it, and book the stock in when it arrives

features.name: Sell at the Counter
features.description: Ring up a sale in the shop — paid in cash or on your own card machine — and the stock comes off

features.name: Carrier Rates at Checkout
features.description: Shoppers enter their ZIP and choose from your shipping carrier's live rates for their cart, instead of your flat or zone rate

features.name: Saved & Scheduled Sales Reports
features.description: Save a sales report — over time, by product, by option, discount codes — and have it emailed as a spreadsheet every week or month

features.name: Stock by Location
features.description: Count stock at each place you keep it; sales take from your first location first, and moving stock between locations keeps the total

features.name: Store Accelerated Checkout
features.description: Shoppers keep a card on the shop's own Stripe account (with their consent) and pay in one tap — at checkout, from order history, and with Apple Pay, Google Pay and Link buttons

features.name: Store Audiences & Purchase Tags
features.description: Send a customer segment to Meta and Google Ads as a hashed audience (file or direct), and report purchases to Meta and Google Tag Manager

features.name: Store Apps & Integrations
features.description: One page listing every account the shop connects (payments, shipping, QuickBooks, email, reviews, Google and Meta), with whether it is connected and where to change it

features.name: Store API
features.description: Keys, each limited to what it may read or change, so a script or another system can read products, orders, customers and stock, and change stock counts

features.name: Store Webhooks
features.description: The shop posts orders created, paid, fulfilled and refunded, and product and stock changes, to addresses you give it, signed, with retries and a delivery log
